Comment "CLIENT" and I'll send you the link

Claude Code can build you a dashboard that shows every client their own live numbers.

Normally that's custom software you'd pay a developer thousands to build. Now you describe it instead.

You tell Claude what to show, hook it up to the spreadsheet you already keep, and it builds the whole thing as a real web page.

Each client gets one link with their numbers, their results, their progress. Update the sheet and every dashboard updates with it.

#claudecode #aiforbusiness #dashboards #claudeai #aitools

Comment "CREW" and I'll send you the link

crewAI is a free framework that turns your AI into a whole team.

Instead of one AI trying to do everything, you build a team where each agent has one job.

Say you want a market report. One agent pulls the research, another writes the draft, a third fact-checks it, and a fourth cleans it up. You just get the finished report.

A chat answers questions. A crew runs a process, and processes are what actually run businesses.

Set it up once and it runs whenever you need it, without you managing a single step.

#crewai #aiagents #aiautomation #aitools #ai

Comment "MIRO" and I'll send you the link

Miro shipped an MCP that connects every board you own directly to Claude.

Claude can read and search your boards, build new ones, and act on the comments your team left behind.

I dropped in a brainstorm board with 80 sticky notes and got back a ranked priority list with owners and timelines.

The one I keep coming back to is meetings, where you run the session in Miro, close it out, and the recap, action items, and project plan are already waiting.

#miro #claudeai #mcp #anthropic #aitools
